# Doll

> A local narrator. https://doll.sociallydead.me/

Doll speaks a markdown page, and she sings when the page asks. Qt Quick is the studio. Vulkan draws the doll. Doll Script is MAGIC.

## Pages

- [The room](https://doll.sociallydead.me/): the dolls, the voice, the stage, and Contribute
- [Doll Script](https://doll.sociallydead.me/script/): names, events, page marks, singing, and the picture modules
